text:
alex wong: saw a customer report: their dashboard briefly showed another tenant's alerts after they switched orgs rapidly. not sure if it's UI or backend.

tara nguyen: can you repro? which build / cluster?

alex wong: reproduced on canary (canary-7) with rollout v2 of routing-affinity. pattern: org1 -> org2 -> org1, then alert list includes 1-2 items from org2.

luis garcia: sounds like a background fetch/worker race where context headers are captured at enqueue time. our background fetcher serializes headers into the job blob. if session changes, job runs with stale headers.

alex wong: snagged a trace: 
```
[2025-05-10T09:44:10Z] ui: switch org to org2 (user=acct-9)
[2025-05-10T09:44:11Z] enqueue background_fetch job job=jb-33 headers={"x-org":"org1","cookie":"sess-33"}
[2025-05-10T09:44:12Z] session rotate -> sess-34 org=org2
[2025-05-10T09:44:12Z] worker process jb-33 uses headers.x-org=org1 -> returns alerts(org1)
[2025-05-10T09:44:13Z] ui merges alerts into current list (org2 visible header) -> mixed tenant rows
```

tara nguyen: ugh. This also impacts quota attribution because usage logs from the worker are labeled by headers.x-org. Billing could charge wrong tenant.

luis garcia: short term mitigation idea: never persist tenant-identifying headers in job blobs. Store only an auth token reference (session id) and resolve the auth state at run time. That way worker always uses freshest mapping.

alex wong: that's clean but might be a bigger change for the old queue consumers. any quicker guard we can land this week?

tara nguyen: intermediate: add validation at job start: compare job.headers['x-org'] to sessionService.resolve(job.session).org; if mismatch, re-resolve and re-fetch. Also increment telemetry counter `bg_fetch_org_mismatch` with fields {expected, actual}. Fail open: re-fetch with correct org and continue.

luis garcia: good. I'll draft a minimal patch that adds that check and a feature flag `bg_fetch_strict_org_check` default on for canary. Also add a small unit test that simulates session rotation mid-queue.

alex wong: + add an e2e smoke that runs quick switch loop 100x and asserts no cross-tenant rows. we should gate merges on that passing.

ci-bot: CI queued for branch fix/bg-fetch-org-resolve - tests: unit(24), integration(8).

ops-bot: Note: if this fix touches worker startup, watch memory usage during canary - previous changes caused a small leak on worker-3.

tara nguyen: thanks ops. we'll deploy canary to canary-7 only with 10% traffic and watch telemetry. also create an alert: `prefetch_org_mismatch.rate > 1/min` -> paging to eng-platform.

luis garcia: opened PR #4321 with the validation + telemetry + feature flag. added rollout notes and a revert step.

alex wong: reviewing now. also please include a migration note for older queued jobs that may still contain headers; we should reject old blobs older than 24h and force re-enqueue.

tara nguyen: good call. add a compensating job to scan recent queue and requeue with resolved session references.

ci-bot: CI passed for branch fix/bg-fetch-org-resolve (all checks green).

ops-bot: Deployed fix/bg-fetch-org-resolve to canary-7 at 2025-05-10T10:17:45Z. Canary traffic: 10%

alex wong: after canary deploy ran 500 quick-switch iterations; saw 0 mismatches. tagged logs and closed the incident ticket. thanks everyone. :tada:
